test_title: PYST 1: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Babbal is / a oldest member / in our / Black Ice Club.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**a oldest member**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The grammatical error in the given sentence is in the segment "a oldes
